subject: Johnson v. Johnson, 2025CV936 — Woodbine hearing (Chief Judge Scarlett, 11:00 AM) — final prep and approval queue

body.text: APPROVAL QUEUE (CHECK BEFORE LEAVING)
Caption and case number on every paper you carry: Johnson v. Johnson, Civil Action No. 2025CV936, Camden County Superior Court.
Time and location: Thursday, April 16, 2026; Woodbine; hearing at 11:00 AM; remote appearance for opposing counsel (WebEx) per your notes — confirm login and backup audio.
ADA support person notified and available: Brenda O'Dell (brendaodell54@gmail.com).
CP 575E (EIN confirmation for P31 Labs, Inc., 42-1888158): physical copy in folder — checkbox here: [ ] original or certified-quality copy present.
Styled discovery set already transmitted: Supplemental Discovery Notice, Business Documentation, Response to Good-Faith Letter — carry PDF backup or counsel email confirmation screenshot.
PeachCourt filing confirmation for Motion for Protective Order: E-NLC3ERUM — [ ] copy in folder.
Supersedeas and Notice of Appeal (documents 13–14 in your index) — [ ] in folder if you intend to reference them.
Hearing Ops PWA (ops.p31ca.org) loaded on phone — [ ] offline cache refreshed if you rely on it in the building.
VOIR / DEMEANOR
Address the Court, not opposing counsel, unless the judge directs otherwise.
Short sentences. One fact per sentence when under stress.
If asked a compound question, pause and ask to take them one at a time.
CORE THEMES (VERIFY AGAINST FILE BEFORE ARGUING)
These are issue headings for oral argument, not finished legal conclusions. Confirm each point against your filed papers and the clerk's file before stating it as fact.
A. Inchoate / unsigned written order

Third Complaint for Contempt appears to reference an order that is not in the record as a signed, filed written instrument — frame using controlling Georgia authority your research supports (e.g., O.C.G.A. 9-11-58(b); Tate v. Tate; Shirley v. Abshire — verify cite and pocket parts).
B. Discovery posture
March 26, 2026 supplemental production and responses served; specific objections enumerated; Motion for Protective Order pending (E-NLC3ERUM).
C. Corporate / financial transparency
P31 Labs, Inc. incorporated April 3, 2026; EIN 42-1888158 assigned April 13, 2026; nonprofit, no distributions; updated business documentation on file.
IF COUNSEL RAISES BOARD OR governance
One-line explanation (both can be true): Articles name directors; the board has not yet held a formal organizational meeting — formation steps are in progress consistent with a new nonprofit.
TRANSCRIPT / COURT REPORTER

If the status of a prior transcript is material: Evett — ordered/paid ($75.80 on March 19, 2026) — if not received, state for the record that the reporter has been non-responsive and ask the Court for guidance.
OPENING LINE (ADAPT TO JUDGE'S PROMPT)
"Your Honor, William Johnson, pro se, in 2025CV936. I am ready. May I be heard on [contempt basis / protective order / discovery compliance — pick what the Court opens first]?"
CLOSING REQUESTS (TAILOR TO WHAT THE COURT ACTUALLY OPENED)
Ask the Court to take judicial notice of or accept filed exhibits only if they are already admitted or offered consistent with local rule.
If appropriate: request written findings, clarification of any order, and a reasonable schedule for any follow-up the Court requires.
POST-HEARING (FILL IN SAME DAY)
